summary: Dahl Inference's Open Models API homepage advertises 'First 100 million tokens free'. Per the official pricing page and Terms section 8, free tokens (the sign-up grant and free guest keys) expire after 7 consecutive days without a request; any API or chat request restarts the 7 days, and accounts that have topped up keep them. Dahl may change or stop free and bonus token offers at any time.
claim_steps: Sign in / create an account at inference.dahl.global
Make a request at least every 7 days so free tokens do not expire
